scripts.setup: bun run frontend/scripts/setup.ts && bun run infra && bun run migrate
scripts.install:all: bun install --cwd frontend --frozen-lockfile && uv sync --locked --directory backend && bun install --cwd tools/api-client --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
scripts.dev: bun run infra && bun run migrate && bun --env-file=../.env run --cwd frontend dev:stack
scripts.check: bun --env-file=../.env run --cwd frontend typecheck && bun --env-file=../.env run --cwd frontend check && bun --env-file=../.env run --cwd frontend lint:fsd && bun --env-file=../.env run --cwd frontend i18n:check && uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check . && uv run --directory backend mypy && uv run --directory backend python scripts/export_openapi.py --check
scripts.fix: bun --env-file=../.env run --cwd frontend fix && uv run --directory backend ruff format . && uv run --directory backend ruff check --fix . && uv run --directory backend ruff format .
scripts.test: bun --env-file=../.env run --cwd frontend test && uv run --directory backend pytest
scripts.build: bun --env-file=../.env run --cwd frontend build && uv build --directory backend
scripts.api:generate: uv run --directory backend python scripts/export_openapi.py && bun --env-file=../.env run --cwd frontend api:generate
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.migrate:all: bun --env-file=../.env run --cwd frontend auth:db:migrate && uv run --directory backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.preview: bun run infra && bun run migrate && bun --env-file=../.env run --cwd frontend preview:stack
